summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K announcing changes to the composition of its Statutory Audit Committee (CAE), a routine governance matter. The Board of Directors approved two new independent members, Renato Campos Galuppo and Marcelo Gasparino da Silva, effective July 10, 2026, and an interim chair transition. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or transaction details are involved. This is a disclosure of internal committee appointments with no special-situation event. As a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, the filing maps to a US current report but lacks any merger, acquisition, or activist trigger.
